table.name: cheap — the borrowed MEAN over every leg, the sibling's measured overhead

dear — the borrowed MAX on every thread (135.232 s was ONE of the sibling's 75) and two overheads. Pessimistic by construction: the guard's spend is a maximum and a cap blown after the money is spent cannot be un-spent
